outline: 由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
schedule:
1.SPM(STM, AFM, KFM, MFM)
2.Optical analysis(UV-Vis, Raman, IR, AES, AA)
3.Electrical analysis(I-V, C-V, P-V, Sheet resistance, Hall mobility)
4.X-ray, electron probe(ESCA, Auger, EDS, WDS, EELS, CAISIS, RHEED, XAFS)
assessment:
Mid. term exam. 20%
Final exam. 20%
Report and Presentation 60%
